texts: Keepers scrape the threads off the warm stone with a flat blade.
Well-attended lanterns yield a small heap of threads each night in moth-season.

fields.sentence: Keepers scrape the threads off the warm stone with a flat blade.
parse: (: keeper_scrape (Implication (Member $x keeper) (And (Member (sk_scrape $x) scrape) (Agent (sk_scrape $x) $x) (Theme (sk_scrape $x) sk_thread_1) (Source (sk_scrape $x) sk_stone_1) (Instrument (sk_scrape $x) (sk_blade $x)) (Member (sk_blade $x) blade) (Member (sk_blade $x) flat))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: Motion-result shape is exactly the 'slid the plate off the counter' pattern (Theme object + Source path, no Result atom); the definite plural takes a group witness, 'warm' and 'flat' stay descriptive two-atom predications, and the indefinite blade is a dependent Skolem function of $x under the generic rule.

fields.sentence: Well-attended lanterns yield a small heap of threads each night in moth-season.
parse: (: lantern_yield_rule (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (Member $x well_attended)) (And (Member (sk_yield $x) yield) (Agent (sk_yield $x) $x) (Patient (sk_yield $x) (sk_heap $x)) (Member (sk_heap $x) heap) (Member (sk_heap $x) small) (GroupOf (sk_heap $x) thread) (Time (sk_yield $x) night) (Every (sk_yield $x) 1 day) (Time (sk_yield $x) moth_season))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: 'a small heap of threads' follows the flock-of-birds shape (collective noun by Member + GroupOf on the member kind), and 'small' is a property of the collection itself, which is the one licensed use of a bare Member on a group symbol; 'each night' takes the named-slot Time term plus its implied (Every e 1 day) cycle, and 'in moth-season' a second composing Time atom. The (Every e 1 day) is the instruction set's mechanical named-slot output and so slightly outruns the moth-season restriction, which is nonetheless carried by its own Time atom.
